newsitem.title: HONG KONG: KTP places 227 mln shrs at HK$0.28 each.
newsitem.headline: KTP places 227 mln shrs at HK$0.28 each.

text.p: Sports shoes manufactuer KTP Holdings Ltd will place 227 million new shares, or 16.7 percent of its expanded share capital, to a unit of Ever Fortune Industrial Co Ltd at HK$0.28 each, KTP said in a statement published on Thursday.
KTP said Ever Fortune did not hold any KTP shares prior to the deal, which is expected to complete on November 18.
Proceeds will be used for expansion of production facilities, it said.
KTP shares rose HK$0.015 or 4.69 percent to HK$0.335 in early trade on Thursday. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
